en.metaDesc: CyberGems is an independent one-person project: a set of free, open-source Windows apps built for daily use and shared with the world. No ads, no tracking, no account, GPLv3.
en.title: Built for daily use. Shared for free.
en.introLead: CyberGems began as a personal toolkit born from frustration with everyday Windows applications.
introBody: I found existing tools either lacked essential features, came with hefty price tags, or felt unnecessarily bloated. This prompted me to develop my own solutions.

After countless hours of hobby development and refinement, I successfully replaced nearly all my previous applications with my custom-built alternatives. Recently, I decided to share the entire suite as free open-source software, while continuing to enhance and expand its capabilities.

en.metaDesc: CyberGems apps collect nothing. No accounts, no telemetry, no ads. This site uses privacy-friendly, aggregate analytics with no cookies or personal profiles.
en.subtitle: Short version: the apps collect nothing. This site uses minimal, anonymous analytics to understand which pages are useful.
appsItems: No telemetry, no crash reporting, no analytics SDKs.
No accounts, no cloud sync — your files stay on your PC.
Network is only used when you ask (updates check, uploads you configure).
Update checks (where present) only contact api.github.com, the public GitHub Releases API.
Verifiable: full source under GPLv3, public builds on GitHub.
siteItems: Static site (Astro + GitHub Pages). No cookies, no fingerprinting, no A/B tests.
Download buttons query api.github.com at click-time to resolve the latest .exe — standard GitHub traffic, separate from the aggregate analytics described below.
External links (GitHub, wikis) follow their own policies.
analyticsItems: This site uses Umami Analytics to count visits and understand which pages are useful.
It uses no advertising cookies, cross-site identifiers, fingerprinting or user profiles.
We only use aggregated site metrics; analytics is separate from the apps, which contain no telemetry or analytics SDKs.
Download button clicks and direct-file download starts are recorded as separate anonymous events so they can be filtered independently.
Because files are served by GitHub, the site cannot confirm that a download finished; the second event means the browser was sent to a direct .exe or .zip URL.
The analytics script is loaded from cloud.umami.is, only in production, and is not loaded when the browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control.
en.signText: Windows may warn that the publisher is unknown — expected for an independent project without an (expensive) code-signing certificate. Donations go toward one. You can always verify: compare the SHA with the GitHub release, check VirusTotal, or build from source.
en.storeText: Apps installed from the Microsoft Store are also subject to Microsoft's own privacy practices: Windows and the Store collect install and diagnostic data as described in Microsoft's Privacy Statement. This does not change how CyberGems apps behave: they run offline, collect nothing and send nothing.

Verificable: código completo bajo GPLv3, builds públicos en GitHub.
siteItems: Sitio estático (Astro + GitHub Pages). Sin cookies, sin fingerprinting, sin A/B tests.
Los botones consultan api.github.com al hacer clic para resolver el último .exe — tráfico normal de GitHub, separado de la analítica agregada descrita abajo.
Los enlaces externos (GitHub, wikis) siguen sus propias políticas.
analyticsItems: Este sitio usa Umami Analytics para contar visitas y entender qué páginas son útiles.
No usa cookies publicitarias, identificadores entre sitios, fingerprinting ni perfiles de usuario.
Solo usamos métricas agregadas; la analítica está separada de las apps, que no tienen telemetría ni SDKs de analítica.
Los clics en botones de descarga y los inicios de descarga directa se registran como eventos anónimos separados para poder filtrarlos de forma independiente.

es.signText: Windows puede avisar de editor desconocido — esperado en un proyecto independiente sin certificado de firma (caro). Las donaciones van hacia uno. Siempre puedes verificar: compara el SHA con el release de GitHub, revisa VirusTotal o compila desde el código.

Esto no cambia el comportamiento de las apps de CyberGems: funcionan sin conexión, no recopilan nada y no envían nada.

en.metaDesc: How to install any CyberGems app: Setup .exe installer or portable zip. Windows 10/11 64-bit. Free, no ads, no tracking.
en.subtitle: Free apps for Windows 10 and 11. Choose an installer, or a portable version where available.
en.m1Text: Run the .exe and follow the installation steps. Recommended for everyday use.
en.m2Text: No installation. Extract the ZIP or run the portable EXE, where available.
en.m3Note: Scriptable installs and upgrades. The id is on each app page when published.
en.reqStack: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. See each app page for its specific requirements.
en.signText: “Unknown publisher” is expected (no paid certificate yet). Verify with the release SHA / VirusTotal or build from source.
en.ssOpen: Windows SmartScreen: see how to run the installer (step by step)
en.ssIntro: Windows shows this warning for any installer without a paid code-signing certificate. It does not mean the file is unsafe. The fix takes 10 seconds:
en.ssStep1: Run the Setup .exe you downloaded. Windows may show a blue “Windows protected your PC” dialog.
en.ssStep2: Do NOT click “Don't run”. Instead, click the small “More info” link.
en.ssStep3: Click “Run anyway”. The installer starts normally and everything works as expected.
en.ssWhyText: CyberGems builds are not signed yet, so SmartScreen cannot recognize the publisher. You can verify the file independently: compare the SHA with the GitHub release, scan it on VirusTotal, or build from source.
en.dlg1Text: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen prevented an unrecognized app from starting. Running this app might put your PC at risk.
en.dlg2Note: Click "More info" to expand the warning and see details.

es.subtitle: Apps gratuitas para Windows 10 y 11. Elige el instalador o la versión portable, cuando esté disponible.
es.m1Text: Ejecuta el archivo .exe y sigue los pasos de instalación. Recomendado para el uso diario.
es.m2Text: Sin instalación. Extrae el ZIP o ejecuta el EXE portable, cuando esté disponible.
es.m3Note: Instalación y upgrades scripteables. El id está en cada página cuando se publica.
es.reqStack: Windows 10 u 11 de 64 bits. Consulta los requisitos específicos en la ficha de cada app.
es.signText: “Editor desconocido” es esperado (aún sin certificado de pago). Verifica con el SHA del release / VirusTotal o compilando.
es.ssOpen: Windows SmartScreen: mira cómo ejecutar el instalador (paso a paso)
es.ssIntro: Windows muestra este aviso con cualquier instalador que no tenga un certificado de firma de pago. No significa que el archivo sea inseguro. La solución toma 10 segundos:
es.ssStep1: Ejecuta el Setup .exe que descargaste. Windows puede mostrar el diálogo azul “Windows protegió tu PC”.
es.ssStep2: NO hagas clic en “No ejecutar”. En su lugar, haz clic en el enlace pequeño “Más información”.
es.ssStep3: Haz clic en “Ejecutar de todas formas”. El instalador arranca con normalidad y todo funciona como se espera.
es.ssWhyText: Los builds de CyberGems aún no están firmados, así que SmartScreen no puede reconocer al editor. Puedes verificar el archivo de forma independiente: compara el SHA con el release de GitHub, escanéalo en VirusTotal o compila desde el código.
es.dlg1Text: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen impidió iniciar una aplicación no reconocida. Ejecutar esta aplicación podría poner en riesgo tu equipo.
es.dlg2Note: Haz clic en "Más información" para ver los detalles completos.
